about.title: About ArtAqua
body: ArtAqua is a brand of PostModerna, one of the first companies in Macedonia specialized in designer bathroom equipment, import, trade and installation.
Since 1997, the company has successfully operated on the Macedonian market and has become a recognizable brand offering high-quality services.
The modern design and high quality of the products reflect the goal of following the latest European trends while offering modern, functional and reliable bathroom solutions.
about.brands: The product range includes renowned Italian, Slovenian and Croatian manufacturers, including CERAMICA GRAVENA, GSG, HATRIA, FRIGES, REMER, FIORE, EFFEPI, KOLPA, REFLEX, ARMAL, UNITAS HERC, MINES and AQUAESTIL.

services.title: Services
body: Professional service and strong technical knowledge of the products are key characteristics of the ArtAqua brand.
For products bought in the showroom, ArtAqua offers free delivery to your home in Skopje and professional installation.
In addition to sales and installation, the company can carry out the complete process of bathroom reconstruction in all of its stages.
ArtAqua installs hydro and aero massage systems and additional acrylic bath tub equipment such as underwater spotlights, heaters, chromotherapy and electronic displays.

products.title: Products
products.intro: All six categories from the old website are preserved and ready for a modern one-page product presentation.

categories.title: Bath tubs, shower trays and hydromassage systems
categories.shortDescription: Bath tubs and shower trays made of 100% sanitary acrylic, with hydro and aero massage systems, aromatherapy and chromotherapy options.

categories.title: Shower enclosures
categories.shortDescription: Shower enclosures made of tempered safety glass, hardened at high temperature and aligned with European standards.

categories.title: Sanitary ware
categories.shortDescription: High-quality sanitary ware made from material known locally as porcelain and internationally as vitreous china.

categories.title: Bathroom furniture
categories.shortDescription: Bathroom furniture made from MDF with durable final protection, PVC laminate or multiple layers of high-quality polyurethane finish.

categories.title: Taps and showers
categories.shortDescription: Chromium-plated brass taps with quality cartridge mechanisms that influence durability and warranty length.

categories.title: Accessories
categories.shortDescription: Bathroom accessories made of brass with quality chromium-plating that preserves strength, finish and shine.
